children: Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF) will develop an integrated tourist and residential destination on the Al-Khafji coast overlooking the Arabian Gulf through private sector participation.

The development, spanning around 20 square kilometres (sq km) and featuring a 10-km waterfront along the Arabian Gulf, will be developed by the Gulf Coast Development Company, the sovereign fund said in a statement.
The destination will house eight residential neighborhoods with more than 16,000 housing units, around 1,400 hotel keys, commercial, tourism and educational facilities and marinas.
Development will be completed in three phases, with the first phase, comprising three neighborhoods, expected to be completed in 2030.
The project falls under PIF’s Urban Development & Livability ecosystem, one of six new ecosystems revealed in its 2026-2030 strategy.

Saad Alkroud, Head of Local Real Estate Investments at PIF, said that the project will generate new opportunities for the region’s residents, upgrade the city’s infrastructure and deepen private sector partnerships to deliver sustainable returns.

title: Saudi Arabia’s PIF seeks to develop Al-Khafji project through PPP
